title: CyberUnify
subtitle: Unified SOC dashboard: connect any security tool, see every log in one place
description: Analysts connect any SOC tool through Elasticsearch, Splunk, REST APIs, webhooks, syslog (CEF / key=value) or log files, with presets for Wazuh, ELK, Splunk, Suricata, FortiGate, Cloudflare, CloudSEK, GTB DLP and miniOrange. Logs are mapped to one schema and searched in a single explorer, so one query follows an attacker across tools. Adds explainable risk scoring, ISO 27001 reporting and vendor risk assessment.

title: CyberNet
subtitle: AI-prioritized static code security scanner (SAST)
description: Paste code to find vulnerabilities and leaked secrets. Python gets AST taint analysis that traces user input into dangerous calls; JavaScript, PHP and Java use 70 rules with light taint tracking. A logistic-regression model ranks findings by how likely they are to be real (89% accuracy in cross-validation) and explains each score. Maps to CWE and OWASP Top 10 and exports SARIF.

title: DPDPA Compliance Platform v2
subtitle: Final-year project
description: An engine for real-time data asset discovery, continuous privacy verification and automated DPDPA risk scoring across hybrid endpoints, extending our v1 checklist tool.

title: Continuous Learning IDS
subtitle: Concept-drift-resistant intrusion detection
description: Designing an intrusion detection pipeline for high-volume network telemetry that adapts to shifting attack patterns without full model retraining.

title: Python CI Security Pipeline
subtitle: DevSecOps with Jenkins + Trivy
description: A CI/CD pipeline for a Python app that runs Trivy security scans in Jenkins, so vulnerable dependencies and images are caught before they ship.

title: Containerized DevOps Tools Lab
subtitle: Self-hosted toolchain on Docker
description: Deployed Jenkins, SonarQube, MySQL, Nginx and Ollama as Docker containers, configuring ports, volumes and services to work together.

title: Home SOC Lab
subtitle: Threat detection playground
description: A self-hosted lab that simulates real-world threat detection, with custom detection rules and dashboards that flag anomalous traffic.
